regime.value: ES daily: a strong uptrend from about Nov 2023 to Mar 2024. On 4 Apr ES printed O 5270.75, H 5308.50, L 5192.50, last 5194.25 (-1.37%). ES 4h: it pulled back from late-March highs (≈5,330 ±5) to about 5,240 ±8 on 2-3 Apr, rallied to 5,308.50 on 4 Apr, then fell below the 2-3 Apr low. Intraday ES (5m): it rallied from a pre-open low of ≈5,281 to ≈5,307 at about 09:40 and pulled back to ≈5,292.7 ±0.5 at about 11:10. It broke up at about 11:25, made the day high of 5,308.50 at about 12:05, then sold off hard from about 13:30 to 5,192.50. NQ followed the same path: an open rally to ≈18,550 ±4, a pullback to ≈18,481 ±3 at about 11:15, a high of ≈18,567 ±4, then a sell-off to 18,056.00 (-1.72%).

bias.value: Bullish for 4 Apr on ES and NQ, from the 4h. The pre-market rally gave a range, and he looked for longs on a retrace to the range's equilibrium (50%) overlapping a 1h imbalance. After the close he leans bearish for the rest of the week and possibly a weekly move down, but calls it 'complete speculation'. No explicit draw-on-liquidity level is audible for the day.

no_trade_reason.value: No trade was taken. ES hit equilibrium and broke structure upward, but the retrace entry never came: the ES order block and NQ's new-leg equilibrium were never reached. Price then sold off from about 13:30. He says there were no trades on the day. No position tool, fills or P&L appear in the video.

lessons_stated.value: Take the bias from the 4h, then on the lower timeframe wait for a retrace to equilibrium combined with the hourly imbalance, followed by a break of structure
If price doesn't come back to the entry area (order block / equilibrium) after the break, there is no trade, even if the idea was right up to that point
